summary: community.general keycloak_realm_localization, realm_rolemapping, realm_users_info, keycloak_role, keycloak_user, user_execute_actions_email and user_federation are now redirects requiring middleware_automation.keycloak.
questions: Why does keycloak_user fail after upgrading community.general?

answer_card.title: Keycloak redirects in community.general (part 5)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general modules are now **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. The redirect only works if you **install `middleware_automation.keycloak`**:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Affected modules (each maps to `middleware_automation.keycloak.<name>`):

`keycloak_realm_localization`, `keycloak_realm_rolemapping`, `keycloak_realm_users_info`, `keycloak_role`, `keycloak_user`, `keycloak_user_execute_actions_email`, `keycloak_user_federation`
